coordinate_system: +Y up; +Z front; +X object right. Angles use local joint axes.
notes: 姿势为表演关键帧；模型生成仍使用中性A姿势。不要用不同状态重建多个机器人模型。

states.name: 待机
states.visual_description: Neutral relaxed A-pose as reference, cyan oval eyes, soft antenna light.

states.name: 挥手迎宾
states.visual_description: Raise robot's RIGHT arm in greeting with elbow slightly bent, head yaw 15 degrees toward that hand, bright cyan eyes, warm antenna.

states.name: 指路
states.visual_description: Robot's LEFT arm extends sideways to point with same C-shaped gripper, head yaw minus 25 degrees following arm. Body and feet anchored.

states.name: 休眠
states.visual_description: Arms relaxed, head tilted slightly downward, visor eyes become two short dim blue horizontal sleeping slits, antenna off. Feet unchanged.

generation_policy: 生成3D使用baseline中性造型，动态状态仅用于灯光/关节/形变设定；不对各状态分别生成模型。
reference_accuracy: AI概念关键帧；角度与关节约束以参数为准，不是同一3D网格的精确渲染。
clip_preview: 目录页的关键帧轮播，不是骨骼动画或物理动画。
